policy: Budgets are release gates for the macOS 26+ internal beta. They include headroom above observed same-host baselines and must not be relaxed solely to pass a candidate.

search.scope: 15-character Wikipedia query returning 10 results, including the 300 ms debounce

sidebarHydration.scope: Cold and incremental hydration cohorts up to 30 visible titles

sessionRestore.scope: Local persisted app-state decode and publication; window readiness is verified separately

readerColdReveal.scope: Cold Ada Lovelace reader reveal on the reference internal-beta host

readerWarmReveal.scope: Warm-disk Ada Lovelace reader reveal on the reference internal-beta host
